title: Prove exact Schur minima for arbitrary invertible block pivots (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves the exact prescribed-boundary Schur minimum over **every field** for arbitrary invertible block pivots A,B and arbitrary product block H. The matrices A,B,H need not commute. For commuting idempotents P,Q with `P11=A`, `Q11=B`, `(PQ)11=H`, the least ambient dimension attaining Schur-commutator rank `2d` is

```
n_min = 3d + rank(I-A-B+H)
           + nullity(A-H) + nullity(B-H) + nullity(H).
```

The proof extends the six-map criterion to noncommuting pivots, derives componentwise sector lower bounds and constructs a pair attaining all four bounds and both minimum input ranks simultaneously. An explicit pairwise-noncommuting rational/ternary example attains n=6 at d=2.

This resolves Open next question 1 of #4774 and #4785 and strengthens their requested unequal-scalar-block scope. It does **not** claim #4597's existing ordered factor identity as new. The contribution is a written algebraic theorem with finite corroboration, not a proof-kernel or independently human-accepted theorem. No physical supplier, priced header or new kappa; the selected frontier is unchanged.

## Validation

Python 3.12.12, standard library only. Passed:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/arbitrary-pivot-schur-minimum
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/arbitrary-pivot-schur-minimum --check-source-history
```

The manifest runs both checkers normally and under `-O`, each with `-I -W error -B`:

* Primary: **1,386** exact constructed cases across F_2,F_3,F_5,F_7,Q and d=2,3,4, plus two explicit examples. All 576 binary d=2 input triples are covered; the ternary exhaustive component has 8 noncommuting pivot pairs times all 81 H. Checks include full idempotence/commutation, prescribed blocks, literal Schur products, ordered factors, the six-map criterion and attaining ranks/dimensions.
* Independent bitset implementation: all **576** binary fixtures, including 288 noncommuting A,B inputs and 180 pairwise-noncommuting A,B,H inputs; no primary-code imports.
* Six deficient-map controls, two singular-pivot rejections, seven independent corruption/coverage controls. Each H/B-inverse order mutation is detected on **1,017** primary cases.
* Committed-byte and source-history preflight: 9 package files. Official export and integrity check passed. All four direct commands then passed from a fresh read-only Git-free extraction with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all **10** exported files, including the receipt, remained byte-identical.

Export SHA256: `10575b7c972d21007a7bc06e6f4e60741f7db463036f155ea3714dc7b63a0dc1`.
Export receipt SHA256: `d3788b5d506d3e2997228668ee35043798db715ed20e9a2107309352dee57564`.

The computations corroborate the construction; minimality over all fields comes from PROOF.md, not finite enumeration. No full selected replay, physical admission, or Lean build was run. Hosted CI is pending at publication.

## Open next questions

The [package questions](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2839d35e58b3285a1992a3ecbae2809ebef7661b/research/arbitrary-pivot-schur-minimum/README.md#open-next-questions) separate nonmaximal Schur ranks from physical realization. A bounded next step is a fixed-boundary d=2 binary rank-two classification; the maximal-rank criterion does not decide it. Turning the ternary n=6 witness into a useful header first requires an actual caller and a complete resource bill. Neither follow-up is claimed here.
